item.description: India aims to secure the five-match T20I series against New Zealand today in Wellington after establishing a 2-0 lead.

item.title: Second cold front brings wet and windy conditions across New Zealand
item.description: MetService expects a second weather front to move up the South Island tomorrow, bringing rain and stronger winds.

item.description: The longtime sports media figure and former NFL broadcast assistant died at age 59 while in hospice care.

item.title: Suns Clash With Depleted Thunder Following Jalen Williams' Gruesome Leg Injury
item.description: The Phoenix Suns face the Oklahoma City Thunder on Monday at 7 p.m. CT while the hosts battle a string of significant injuries.

item.title: PSG looks for first Monday win while Lyon eyes past success
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain faces Olympique Lyonnais in a Ligue 1 clash tonight at 20:30.

item.description: Chancellor John Healey is set to introduce a new tax-free allowance to prevent pensioners from paying income tax after the state pension rises in April.

item.title: Alexandra Eala chases breakthrough performance during first trip to Tokyo tournament

item.description: Severe gale winds across New Zealand have triggered orange weather warnings, causing flight disruptions and road closures through Tuesday morning.

item.description: The Infocomm Media Development Authority has issued a show cause notice to Simba after alleging intentional spectrum misuse at over 200 sites.

item.title: October Hunter Moon glows orange as it reaches peak illumination this weekend
item.description: The October full moon reaches 100% illumination just after midnight on Monday, October 26, following its orange-tinted rise at sunset.

item.title: Former Canucks Captain Quinn Hughes Returns To Vancouver For First Time Sunday
item.description: The Minnesota Wild defenseman visits his former home rink at Rogers Arena following his trade last December.

item.title: Kylian Mbappe Snatches Late El Clasico Winner to Close LaLiga Title Gap
item.description: Kylian Mbappe scored an 87th-minute winner to secure a 2-1 victory for Real Madrid over LaLiga leaders Barcelona at Spotify Camp Nou.

item.title: Barcelona and Real Madrid clash in crucial El Clasico title race
item.description: Barcelona faces Real Madrid this Sunday in a decisive match that could effectively end the La Liga title race.

item.title: Dolphins seek first win against Jets in AFC East bottom-two clash

item.title: Hull City seeks fifth point at home as unbeaten Brentford visit MKM Stadium
item.description: Hull City hosts Brentford in a Premier League match where the Tigers aim to extend their strong home record against a Bees side that remains unbeaten on the road.

item.title: Peter Berg's Netflix film traces All-American footballers from Pearl Harbor to Okinawa
item.description: Director Peter Berg's new Netflix war drama "The Mosquito Bowl" tells the true story of elite college football players who volunteered for the Marines after Pearl Harbor and fought in World War II's Pacific theater, including a legendary Christmas Eve 1944 football game at Guadalcanal.

item.title: Winless Manchester United hosts Bournemouth as Michael Carrick faces mounting pressure
item.description: Manchester United takes on Bournemouth in a Premier League fixture as the club struggles through a winless streak lasting nearly two months.

item.title: Kimi Antonelli Beats Max Verstappen to Secure Surprise United States Grand Prix Pole
item.description: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli secured pole position at the Circuit of the Americas, putting him in position to clinch the F1 world championship on Sunday.

item.title: No NDSU Football Updates Available Among Current College Football Week 8 Coverage
item.description: The provided coverage for Week 8 of the college football season does not include results or updates regarding North Dakota State University (NDSU).

item.title: Inter Milan Targets Top Spot Against Lowly Fiorentina in Serie A Clash

item.title: Prince William reveals he tried to remove Travis Kelce from royal selfie

item.description: Joao Pedro is absent from the Chelsea squad for the Premier League fixture against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge.

item.description: The New York Red Bulls hold a 1-0 advantage over Inter Miami at halftime in their crucial Major League Soccer matchup.
